about: How labelled sets are used. Development sets may be read and tuned on. Calibration sets fix confidence thresholds and are never used to change a detector. The sealed set is measured once per release, aggregates only. A sealed or calibration set becomes a development set as soon as its detailed failures are read: record that as an exposure with details_used_for_tuning true and change its role.

roles.development: labels may be read in detail and detectors changed after reading them
roles.calibration: used only to set confidence thresholds; no detector is changed after reading it
roles.sealed: release test: measured once per release with --release, aggregates only
